headline: Does not work in the original game

findings.message: the food pile at row 10, column 10 does not show in the original from stage 1 on: its tile 317 is named "." in the dictionary, the original places no pile of a tile whose picture it does not load, and nobody can see or harvest a pile that is not placed
the hill of Blue is not whole: 4 cells (the first at row 27, column 46) differ from the 4 x 4 hill around its entrance (row 28, column 47)
36 cells use tiles that the dictionary names "." (the first at row 3, column 29: tile 548): the original does not load their pictures, so it does not draw them
